balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.blurb: A classic build: a weekly long run plus alternating tempo and interval days.

polarized.label: Mostly easy
polarized.blurb: Polarized 80/20: mostly genuinely easy running with one hard session a week. Great if you tend to run everything moderately hard.

runwalk.label: Run/Walk
runwalk.blurb: Gentle run/walk intervals and no speedwork — finish feeling strong. Ideal when starting out or returning.

lowfreq.label: Three key runs
lowfreq.blurb: 3-Day Quality: three purposeful runs a week (intervals, tempo, long), with optional cross-training on other days. Best with exactly 3 run days.

hansons.label: Run most days
hansons.blurb: Hansons-style: higher frequency, a capped moderate long run and tempo at goal race pace. Best at 5–6 days for a half or full marathon.

occasional.label: Now and then
occasional.sub: A run every week or two

runWalk.title: Your run/walk ratio
runWalk.note: The plan starts easier and works up to this, never past it. Change it any time and rebuild.
